description: Header file defining the SubscriptionHandler class and related data structures for managing subscriptions, including methods for subscribing, unsubscribing, and publishing data, as well as thread management and external dependencies.

classes.name: UUIDHasher
classes.description: Hash functor for boost::uuids::uuid used in unordered_map.

classes.name: subscription_keys
classes.description: Struct representing a subscription key with path and attribute, including constructor and equality operator.

classes.name: SubscriptionKeyHasher
classes.description: Hash functor for subscription_keys_t, combining VSSPath hash and string hash.

classes.name: SubscriptionHandler
classes.description: Main class managing subscriptions, including methods for subscribing, unsubscribing, publishing, and thread control.

methods.name: addPublisher
methods.description: Adds a publisher to the internal list.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Creates a new subscription for a given channel, database, path, and attribute.

methods.name: unsubscribeAll
methods.description: Removes all subscriptions for a given channel.

methods.name: publishForVSSPath
methods.description: Publishes data for a specific VSS path with given datatype, attribute, and value.

methods.name: isThreadRunning
methods.description: Checks if the thread is active.

methods.name: subThreadRunner
methods.description: Function run by the subscription thread.
